name: westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_submit_pending_session_list
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDialog::SubmitPendingSessionListFromResults builds a transient linked list of pending session requests from result rows and submits it to the WOL API.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x43ef10 verifies cached-browse-record and create-session gates, looping over g_WestwoodOnlineUpgradePendingSessionResultCount, allocating 0x58-byte request nodes, LB_GETTEXT into m_sessionName at offset 0x24, deleting failed rows, TruncateStringAtFirstSpace, head insertion through m_next at offset 0x20, SubmitPendingSessionList through vtable offset 0x48, and cleanup of the transient linked list.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_submit_pending_session_list_smoke uses a real listbox and fake SubmitPendingSessionList slot to verify early gates, null-list submit, reversed linked-list order, first-space truncation, invalid-row skip, and provider self.
